lpcminigame.dieOnTouchingGround.help:
Mini-game "Die On Touching Ground" instructions:
  Game Rules:
    Touching naturally generated blocks after game starts will cause death
    Only stepping on recorded player-placed blocks is safe
    Blocks placed before game starts won't be counted
    Spawn area protected to avoid death loops
  Subcommands:
    start: Begin game
    stop: Pause game
    banVehicle: Toggle vehicle usage
    difficulty: Get or set difficulty (see 'difficulty help' for details)
    clear: Reset game data
    help: Show this prompt
lpcminigame.dieOnTouchingGround.difficul:
Difficulty Levels:
  god:Omni-Strict Detection - Death on any directional contact with naturally generated blocks
  strict:Precision Detection - Death when stepping on even partially natural blocks
  normal:Standard Check - Death triggered by block directly beneath player (including edge cases)
  Another-loose:Lenient Mode 1 - Death only when exclusively stepping on natural blocks
  Dream-loose:Dream-style Detection - Only checks foot block (allows edge-standing via air gaps)
  loosest:Ultra-Lenient - Requires natural block beneath AND no contact with player-placed blocks
